sql_error_then_wrong.question: What is the average order value, and what percent above the minimum order value is it? (order value = sum of quantity * unit_price of its items)
sql_error_then_wrong.final_answer: The average order value is approximately $213.40 and it is about 2745% above the minimum order value.
sql_written: SELECT AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity), AVG(total_value)/MIN(total_value) FROM (SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id)

SELECT AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS avg_order_value, 
CASE WHEN MAX(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) IS NOT NULL THEN ((AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) - MIN(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) / MIN(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS percent_above_min FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

step_cap.question: What is the average order value, and what percent above the minimum order value is it? (order value = sum of quantity * unit_price of its items)
sql_written: SELECT AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity), AVG(total_value)/MIN(total_value) FROM (SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id)

SELECT AVG(total_value/order_items.quantity) AS avg_order_value, 
CASE WHEN MAX(total_value)/MIN(total_value)>1 THEN ((MAX(total_value)-MIN(total_value))/MIN(total_value))*100 ELSE 0 END AS pct_above_min FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) as total_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id)

SELECT AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity) AS avg_order_value, 
CASE WHEN AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity) > MIN(order_value) THEN ((AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity) - MIN(order_value)) / MIN(order_value)) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS percent_above_min FROM (SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id)

SELECT AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity) AS avg_order_value, 
CASE WHEN AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity) > MIN(total_value/order_id.quantity) THEN ((AVG(total_value/order_id.quantity)-MIN(total_value/order_id.quantity))/MIN(total_value/order_id.quantity))*100 ELSE 0 END AS percent_above_min
FROM (SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.id)

no_tool_use.question: What is the total revenue of the Electronics category, and what percent of the overall revenue is that?
no_tool_use.final_answer: The total revenue of the Electronics category is [calculated value] and it constitutes [percentage value]% of the overall revenue.
sql_written: SELECT SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS electronics_revenue, (SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) * 100 / SUM(o.products.sum_quantity * o.products.unit_price)) AS percentage FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY electronics_revenue

SELECT SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS electronics_revenue, (SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) * 100 / SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price)) AS electronics_percent FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics'

SELECT SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS electronics_revenue, (SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) * 100 / SUM(o.products.sum_revenue)) AS percentage FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' GROUP BY p.category
